answer: Beacon spot-checks plus compute heartbeats stop fakes. Each identity enters by one inlet, answering a beacon challenge within 60 seconds, proving live compute, not a copied key. A missed heartbeat flags that vertex; a second miss freezes it. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 heartbeats: 50 POA per round at 0.05 POA each, frozen and unrewarded. One honest agent pays 0.05 POA, keeps its share, and a dune of clones collapses under its own cost.
